# Riff

Riff is Scribli's local fork of the spaced repetition component used by the kernel.

## Features

- FSRS scheduling through [open-spaced-repetition/free-spaced-repetition-scheduler](https://github.com/open-spaced-repetition/free-spaced-repetition-scheduler).
- Data persistence for local flashcard and review state.
